source.title: Nonlinear buckling behavior of a complete spherical shell under uniform external pressure and homogenous natural curvature
source.authors: Douglas P. Holmes, Jeong-Ho Lee, Harold S. Park, Matteo Pezzulla
source.locator: Eq. (1), p. 023003-3; zero-curvature limit Eq. (86), p. 023003-12

quantity: Ideal elastic bifurcation pressure of a perfect complete spherical shell; no collapse or knockdown validation
input_basis: Explicit numerical instantiation of the published general equation. These dimensional parameters are builder-selected, not a reported physical specimen. Source assumptions: perfect complete homogeneous isotropic elastic sphere, uniform pressure, zero natural-curvature stimulus.
material: Linear isotropic elasticity only; no strength/yield inputs or density required for this eigenproblem
loading: Uniform inward pressure on the closed shell; outward normals and negative CalculiX shell P (manual section 6.2.14). No prior static preload; the BUCKLE step internally computes reference stress.
boundary_conditions: Only six tangential displacement constraints to remove rigid motions: ux=uy=0 at both z poles, uy=uz=0 at x=R. These leave uniform radial contraction free and fix a rigid-motion gauge; no symmetry reduction.
imperfection: None: ideal eigenvalue comparator; no nonlinear collapse claim
element: CalculiX S8R expanded quadratic reduced-integration shell; exact radial normals at every element node; Gmsh six conforming spherical quadrilateral patches
mesh_convergence_rule: At least three frozen meshes. Both successive relative changes abs(p_new-p_old)/abs(p_new) <= 0.01; inspect all eight eigenvalues for clusters/mode switching. No fortunate-mesh selection. Otherwise no PASS.
comparison: abs(p_fine-published)/abs(published) <= 0.05 AND the declared convergence rule; report the whole sequence
scope: Numerical reproduction of the source's classical ideal equation, not a vacuum-hull feasibility result

numerical_settings.retry_policy: No retries, tuning, mesh changes, extra threading sweep or mode substitution; stop on a required model change.

execution_protocol: Regenerate all three physical decks using the original pinned sphere_deck function inside the bounded scope. Check n24 against the original deck hash before any solve. Then pass each regenerated frozen deck to the unchanged original runner --deck branch, once per mesh with --threads 1. Keep all original records immutable.
